interaction_history.overview: Young and impulsive Rosetta lives with her alcoholic mother and, moved by despair, she will do anything to maintain a job.
interaction_history.title: Rosetta

interaction_history.overview: Director Michael Apted revisits the same group of British-born adults after a 7 year wait. The subjects are interviewed as to the changes that have occurred in their lives during the last seven years.
interaction_history.title: 42 Up

interaction_history.overview: Two schizophrenics meet during therapy and fall in love. Unfortunately they are on a road to nowhere...
interaction_history.title: Angel Baby

interaction_history.overview: Apu is a jobless ex-student dreaming vaguely of a future as a writer. An old college friend talks him into a visit up-country to a village wedding....
interaction_history.title: World of Apu, The (Apur Sansar)

interaction_history.overview: Lola receives a phone call from her boyfriend Manni. He lost 100,000 DM in a subway train that belongs to a very bad guy. She has 20 minutes to raise this amount and meet Manni. Otherwise, he will rob a store to get the money. Three different alternatives may happen depending on some minor event along Lola's run.
interaction_history.title: Run Lola Run (Lola rennt)

interaction_history.overview: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.
interaction_history.title: 400 Blows, The (Les Quatre cents coups)

interaction_history.overview: Professional photographer L.B. "Jeff" Jeffries breaks his leg while getting an action shot at an auto race. Confined to his New York apartment, he spends his time looking out of the rear window observing the neighbors. He begins to suspect that a man across the courtyard may have murdered his wife. Jeff enlists the help of his high society fashion-consultant girlfriend Lisa Freemont and his visiting nurse Stella to investigate.
interaction_history.title: Rear Window

interaction_history.overview: A self-conscious bride is tormented by the memory of her husband's dead first wife.
interaction_history.title: Rebecca

interaction_history.overview: The Killing Fields tells the real life story of a friendship between two journalists, an American and a Cambodian, during the bloody Khmer Rouge takeover of Cambodia in 1975, which lead to the death of 2-3 million Cambodians during the next four years, until Pol Pot's regime was toppled by the intervening Vietnamese in 1979.
interaction_history.title: Killing Fields, The

interaction_history.overview: Dramatization of the Starkweather-Fugate killing spree of the 1950s, in which a teenage girl and her twenty-something boyfriend slaughtered her entire family and several others in the Dakota badlands.
interaction_history.title: Badlands
